name: generate_video
title: Generate a video with Veo
description: Generate a video from a text prompt with Google Veo, optionally starting from an image (image-to-video) and ending on another one. Paid per second of video and takes 1-5 minutes, so ask before generating several variants. Saves an MP4 to disk and returns its path.

prompt.description: What happens in the video, including camera and sound

image.description: Path to the first frame: png, jpg or webp

lastFrame.description: Path to the last frame. Requires image

model.description: Veo model id, default veo-3.1-generate-preview. See list_models

name: fetch_video
title: Fetch a Veo video by operation
description: Wait for an already started Veo operation and save its video. Use it when generate_video failed after the render had started: its error names the operation. Costs nothing extra.

operation.description: Operation name from the error, models/.../operations/...

name: list_models
title: List Veo models
description: List Veo model ids available to this API key.
